subject.title: fix(active-memory): honor abortSignal during recall cleanup retry delays

question: Should cancelled recalls be allowed to stop session-artifact cleanup retries when that can leave the released session-write-lock recovery incomplete?
rationale: The branch intentionally trades durable cleanup for lower cancellation latency, but the latest release describes lock release as necessary to prevent later user messages from waiting or requiring manual intervention.

options.title: Decouple durable cleanup from recall cancellation
options.body: Return the recall promptly while retaining a bounded cleanup owner that can finish releasing the session artifact, and add a next-recall regression test.

options.title: Accept abandoned cleanup on cancellation
options.body: Adopt the branch's current behavior only with explicit maintainer acceptance that a cancelled recall may leave recovery work for later cleanup.

recommendation.title: Decouple durable cleanup from recall cancellation
recommendation.body: Return the recall promptly while retaining a bounded cleanup owner that can finish releasing the session artifact, and add a next-recall regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: The v2026.7.1 release identifies this person among the contributors to the embedded-run session-lock recovery contract.
